final.narration: Published river flows appear to be running about 12% too high, as recent field measurements show the river carrying less water than the official rating predicts. Debris backing up flow downstream is the most likely cause, though our confidence is only moderate. Field crews should inspect the river control section and clear out any trapped debris. Trust score 73/100 (Watch).

final.skeptic_argument: The observed residual is -11.6%, which matches the expected negative sign for debris, and the field notes repeatedly report 'Debris - Moderate'/'Debris - Light' across 11 visits. The channel geometry is also consistent with downstream control/backwater effects: velocity fell 25.9% while area changed only 22.5%, so the evidence supports debris (with fill as a plausible alternative) rather than a sign or channel-geometry mismatch.
